name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 12 – Am 36
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 12a. Stresses that the EU-Israel Association Agreement is, according to Article 2 of that agreement, based on the fulfilment of human rights and emphasises these as a guiding principle; notes that Israel stands accused of genocide and calls, therefore, for the immediate termination of the EU-Israel Association Agreement;
